package.original_build_project_user_state_and_ru: All four protected state hashes and 754 upstream Rust file hashes verified unchanged.
package.runtime_qualification: Native Debug/Release evidence and universal build metadata; physical Intel, macOS14/26 and live Photato/Photoshop qualification remain open.

api.adobe: Expanded POST /v2/edit for light, color saturation/vibrance, effects, noiseReduction, sharpness and sharpen. Existing async jobs/output contract retained. Color-only edit rendering now uses the same Camera Raw development pipeline instead of the earlier ClassicAdjustment approximation.
api.endpoint_groups: Five partial/three unimplemented; no complete Adobe endpoint or proprietary output equivalence claim.

limitations: RGB raster/Smart Object Camera Raw Filter only; actual sensor RAW/DNG decode, source preservation, lens corrections, local RAW masks, highlight recovery and XMP/preset interoperability remain open.
8,388,608 layer pixels; existing API request/document/resource limits also apply. Large-image interactive performance remains to be qualified.
Editable PSD/PSB Camera Raw descriptors fail explicitly; save .photato to retain editability.
Native settings JSON is Photato-specific, not Adobe XMP. Point-curve display connects control points; finer curve visualization/accessibility/keyboard fidelity remains open.

Exact Adobe/Rust numerical identity, physical Intel/macOS14/26 runtime and live UI qualification remain open. The Mac was last observed locked; offscreen hosting tests are not live interaction evidence.
